[SWS_DM_01781] (Re-)Identification of Clients by Token
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04268
⌈
For any subsequent request that is processed no later than the
validUntil
re-
turned from the
ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorization
and where the authorization token is identical, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall consider the client as being identical.
⌋
